Add the Webhook notification provider (#154)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-31
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - add the shared `codeoo-notification-webhook` crate with secret-free configuration snapshots and send-time endpoint and bearer resolution
    - render deterministic Markdown or plaintext, persist exact bytes plus closed delivery metadata, and send bounded Codeoo headers without the semantic JSON envelope
    - classify HTTP and transport outcomes, cap `Retry-After`, redact endpoint/credential/provider data, and document the provider contract
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeoo-notification-core -p codeoo-notification-webhook --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo test -p codeoo-notification-core -p codeoo-notification-webhook --locked` (29 passed)
    
    ## Notes
    
    The OpenWiki generator could not refresh because its tool home is read-only. The maintained normative Webhook specification is included, and unauthorized partial generator output was removed.
